subject: q10jb built: step breadcrumbs inside relay open/reap/INFO/close (sha e266ef93, spare 4096)
body: Image gpu/build/device-mmu-q10jb-candidate/ui-sched/nord2-ios-metal-q10jb-ui654fb60dvfs-cap3500-ram3776-sched.img sha256 e266ef936f600975729b4d6125e45b35da773fe14c7f28ea26a63b9253ca941d, 33550336 B, spare 4096, FAILURES none, kernel 54276da8; 0310 = 246a4224. From the first minor-1 entry on, 60 steps print 'NORD2 VCT r<n>' + 300 ms: open r0 entry, r1 proc_pid done, r2 proc_find ok (r9 NULL), r3 lock taken, r4/r5 existing slot yes/no, r6 before unlock, r7 return; reap r10 (n>0), r11 proc_find ok (r19 NULL), r12 alive (r18 dead), r13 rele done, r14 relocked, r15/r16 done; INFO r20/r21 (after K02 info)/r22; close r30/r31 (r39 no slot)/r32/r33. Minor-1 entry wait now 300 ms (was 1.5 s): if no r0 follows 'VCT o1', the wait itself is the problem. Reading of vc6b: I believe the '=0' after 'o1 p43 #29' IS the open's result (server recv only returns 0 for data/close notices, and nothing had been sent; open is the only other outstanding call, 1.5 s spin then body) and '=60' is vcodecd's #30 timeout; after that BOTH threads were in their 0.5 s exit delay and neither printed again (probe's INFO 'i1', vcodecd's next 'i0'), so the death is right after the open RETURNED: in spec_open/vn_open after d_open, or at the first reap with a client slot (vcodecd's next recv) / the probe's INFO. Disassembly of n2vr_open (q10ja): calls only n2vr_trace, proc_pid, proc_find, lck_mtx_lock, n2vr_by_proc, lck_mtx_unlock, proc_rele, proc_uniqueid, printf, delay: no allocation, no msleep. Probe guest file unchanged from q10ja.
